name: C++: CPE-20-01 C++ Certified Entry-Level Programmer (C++ Institute)
material_vintage: C++ Institute CPE-20-01 exam syllabus (active version of CPE-20-0x), fetched live on 2026-09-26 from the CPE certification page and itemised in full: every numbered objective (1.1-4.5) is one item. Exam format: 30 items (single-choice, multiple-choice, gap fill, drag and drop); 45 minutes; pass mark 70%; block weights 28/28/24/20%. The C++ Institute publishes no past papers: every item is original. Exam-dump sites were not used. Every code-output answer key was generated by compiling (g++, C++17) and running the code; 'does not compile' answers come from the compiler itself.
level_source: standalone: a vendor certification with no RQF/FHEQ level
